content:
irene: PM asks for a short changelog + micro-migration for the latency-first routing opt-in. Release target 2026-05-18, docs due 2026-05-14.

mike: I can draft. Eng: flag is routing.prefer_latency (bool, default false). If true, router prefers latency-optimized variants, falling back to cost-optimized when needed. Note: streaming + fallback can emit a brief partial chunk.

tony: Draft changelog: "Latency-first routing (opt-in): add routing.prefer_latency to prioritize low-latency model variants. Existing behavior unchanged unless opted in."

sam: I'll add two tiny snippets and a cache note. JS snippet:
```js
// JS SDK v2
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'rwk-1', prompt: 'Write a note', routing: { prefer_latency: true } });
```
Python snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
c.generate(model='rwk-1', prompt='Write a note', routing={'prefer_latency': True})
```

sam: Cache note: enabling this can reduce prefix/KV cache hit rate transiently; expect slight token-cost variance while caches warm. Rollout: gradual 48h with auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: branch created: refs/heads/docs/latency-optin-may18 by sam (CI queued).

mike: tagging for tech signoff. Merge after green CI + staging preview.

irene: thanks all 44d"
